DispatcherRoute.description:
#51's route shape, with the route's id and its van's plate. Live
stops only.
DispatcherRoute.title: DispatcherRoute

OptimisationJobAccepted.description:
202 body. No status: a retried POST gets the same job back, which may
have moved on from queued; GET says where it is.
OptimisationJobAccepted.title: OptimisationJobAccepted

OptimisationJobResult.description:
A job and, once completed, its plan. Every requested pickup is in a
route; the late ones are also in late, and the rest in unassigned, so a
missed deadline is always listed, never left to be noticed.
OptimisationJobResult.title: OptimisationJobResult

PickupReportTimeUpdate.description:
A flight delay (or any roster change) recorded for one pickup. It
never starts a re-plan: the dispatcher does that with POST
/optimisation-jobs.
PickupReportTimeUpdate.title: PickupReportTimeUpdate

ScheduleChangeNotice.description:
A re-plan changed this pickup (#53): what crew had been told, and
what now holds. Acknowledged with POST
/crew/me/notices/{id}/acknowledge.
ScheduleChangeNotice.title: ScheduleChangeNotice

post.description:
The crew member has seen a change to their pickup (#53). Safe to
retry: a notice already acknowledged keeps its first time.

get.description:
Newest first. Crew get their own; the dispatcher gets every crew
member's, ?unread=true for those not yet read.

post.description:
Crew send a preset to the dispatcher. Safe to retry with the same
Idempotency-Key: the retry gets the message already sent.

The dispatcher has read a message. Safe to retry: the first time
stands.

422.description: Unprocessable Content: validation_failed, idempotency_key_reused, duplicate_ids, unknown_ids, not_plannable

get.description: The pickups reporting on a day, in report-time order.

patch.description: Record a new report time (a flight delay). Starts no re-plan.

get.description: The presets crew may send. A fixed set, so not paginated.
The active routes leaving the depot on a day, with their live stops.
Every vehicle, in plate order, with whether it is on the road.

patch.description: Set a vehicle's status, e.g. broken_down. Starts no re-plan.
